cases.name: Fading Light
cases.title: Fading Light — Bring the shared chart up beside the first working lamp
cases.message: the shared flash chart precedes secondary recipes without changing an update
cases.steps: Move the intact section.chart-section, with its SVG, all dots/curves and helper paragraphs, immediately after #first-flash-lamp. Leave threshold/time/readout paragraphs in their existing relative order after the chart. Preserve any already-shipped #chart-seconds from686. Keep both secondary flash and pulse sections after this chart. Do not clone the chart or move any lamp, input, clock handler or memory control.
cases.palette: midnight #101820, cream #fff3dc, grey #b8bcc6, gold #ffd166, coral #e9755c; existing Georgia22/system16
copy: The dotted line is this update. Gold is the first flash, coral the second, and grey the pulse train; each dot matches its lamp.
